content: Ukɔɔn atsüül un'tɔŋ nsaŋ
Lun'wɛl mbuur awe anà gyɔ̈ɔ̈là unsà làkwikilà, twon lan'ler an'kyän ande pànsi pànsi.
Làkwikilà a mbuur mwɛy lun'paa mbwo mudyà undiir wanswà, wɛɛ wumwɛy, u mbwo a gyɔ̈ɔ̈là, afàdyà ndon mpɛl.
Wɛy mbuur afàdyà, ukɔɔn adyà un'siinà mbuur mpa afàdyà anà mbuur mpa afàdyà ukɔɔn atsüül mbuur afàdyà nsaŋ, ntɔn Nzam kàkyun'wal.
Ngye, ngye awà nà mutsüül un'syääl abar nsaŋ? Itàkal naa nde wàŋàtsim, itàkal naa nde wàŋàbwà, ntɔn Mwol we anà ikɔ̈b mukun'mbaar.
Akà mbuur umwɛy, ye anà nsöön uboo a ilä. Akà wumwɛy, bya byanswà byà mfun. Wɛy mbuur mbuur, amu an'kyän ande ŋakwo, ukäl aŋàsà kam.

Mbuur afàsà ilä un'tal, nde afàkyer ntɔn Mwol. Mbuur afàdyà indiir byanswà, nde afàkyer ntɔn Mwol, nde afàfuur an'tɔɔn akà Nzam. Mbuur mpa afàdyà bya byanswà afàfuur an'tɔɔn sye akà Nzam.
Kyakin, kà we anà umwey anki uboo a bi afàkal anà mɔ̈ɔ̈ ntɔn nde mpɛl, kà umwey anki sye afàkwà ntɔn nde ŋakwo.
Ntɔn, isàkal naa bi ibye anà mɔ̈ɔ̈, bi ibà ntɔn Mwol. Isàkal naa bi kan'kwà, bi kan'kwà ntɔn Mwol. Lalan, itàkal naa bi ibye anà mɔ̈ɔ̈, itàkal naa bi kan'kwà, bi ibà ntɔn Mwol.
Lalan, ntɔn mukal Mwol a akü anà wà baar a mɔ̈ɔ̈ waa Klistɔ kàkü anà kàfyefurà u mɔ̈ɔ̈.
Wɛɛ ngye, ntɔn nkye atsüülà ngye un'tɔŋ angye nsaŋ? Abun, bi banswà isàkal kusà a làbay a nsaŋ a Nzam.
Asànaa kàtɛn Mwol:

content.text: « Mɛ, Mwol in'wà anà mɔ̈ɔ̈, an'kyey naa:
baar banswà bàsyebwà an'köm kusà amɛ,

content: Abun, mbuur mbuur uboo a bi asàkyer asà un'lɔɔn akà Nzam ntɔn nde ŋakwo.
Nkɔ̈ɔ̈n abwiy un'tɔŋ
Bi ikyer awɛy mutsuul nsaŋ bamwɛy anà bumwey, wɛɛ làkyer naa bɛ làkɔ̈ɔ̈n akal isin a mbweel a un'tɔŋ.
Akà mɛ, mɛ in'kyàyöb, mɛ an'sà kam unsà Mwol Yɛsu naa: undiir a ŋingyäy watɛy. Wɛɛ undiir a ŋingyäy wà akà mbuur awà kan'kyey naa wa wà abun.
Isàkal naa un'tɔŋ angye kan'man ngyɛb ntɔn isaa an'dyà ngye, ngye afàkal anki uboo a ukwen. U mbwo a isaa angye, twon an'bwiy mbuur awà kàkweel Yɛsu.
Wɛy undiir aŋàbwaŋ ntɔn bɛ ukɔ̈ɔ̈n akal ntɔn mutwee bɛ.
Ntɔn, Imwol a Nzam kà kyà udyà anà unwà anki, wɛɛ balàbal, duu anà un'sak amu Dweelà In'kyɛɛl.
Mbuur ufàsyääl Klistɔ abà, asànaa un'sɔ, Nzam akyer afun'kyey, baar bàkyer afun'kwen.
Lalan, bi ilab indiir byàfàpà duu anà indiir byàfàtɔŋ itɔŋ.
Twon an'dwa isal a Nzam ntɔn isaa. Ndandaa, indiir byanswà byàŋàpɔŋà, wɛɛ yà ube mudyà undiir kan'kwo mukal kyà ntɔn un'tɔŋ.
Yubwaŋ mukɔɔn adyà in'twaŋ, itàkal unwà man bàfàyɔr, itàkal undiir asin kan'kwo mubwiy un'tɔŋ angye.
Kaar ntɔn ngye, kusà a Nzam, làkwikilà awà ngye alà. Un'sak akà mbuur mpa afàtsüül nsaŋ nde ŋakwo ntɔn nsɔ̈ɔ̈l ande ufàsyääl nde.

Wɛɛ mbuur akadyaa anà nkyɛɛr, nde wàŋàkwà ndwà, ntɔn nkääl ande kà yan'fà anki u nsyeel a kam ande unsà làkwikilà. Kyekà, undiir wanswà mpa afàfà u nsyeel a kam unsà làkwikilà wà man'be.
